timing_scope: Recorded phase wall time; earlier work unknown; UTC clock changes can affect duration.

incidents.summary: Several atomic patches included mismatched trailing context, and one map command initially selected the root working directory rather than the isolated feature checkout.
evidence: Patch validation rejected the changes atomically; source readback confirmed no partial edits.
Wrong-root map session27883 was interrupted before writing; git diff --name-only docs/system_map.json remained empty. Correct isolated update72963 completed.
incidents.resolution: Use narrow exact patch contexts and explicit workdir for each mutation; verify root remains untouched and run map only in the isolated checkout. No gameplay regression or lost human work observed.
incidents.repair_time_scope: Small authoring corrections mixed into implementation interval; no invented separate repair duration.

tokens.measurement: Actual Codex cumulative metadata deltas. Phase labels are approximate completion-time attribution, not request-level tracing.
tokens.coverage: Partial: through recorded receipt timestamps; active phase/final reply and earlier work excluded. Lead-only intervals; no dollar or all-service claim.

limitations: Zero observed regressions does not establish regression-free behavior.
Historical incidents without tracked repair intervals have unknown repair time.
Counts and durations are cooperative bookkeeping, not tamper-proof telemetry.
